chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rabi'i ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), whenever he heard the Mu'adhdhin giving the Adhan, would say similar to what he was saying in every phrase.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad do when he heard the call to prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the Sunnah of echoing the Mu'adhdhin's words, a practice deeply rooted in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) consistent adherence to ritual norms. It underscores the spiritual significance of the Adhan as a divine invitation, reinforcing the believer's active participation in the call to prayer through verbal affirmation. This tradition is foundational in Shia fiqh for determining the etiquette (adab) of listening to and responding to the call.
